blocks.html: Robinsons Town Mall Malabon is pleased to present an Art Exhibition celebrating the brilliance and innovativeness of Filipino Artists. Dubbed as “Figura Filipina ATBP”, the exhibit opens on June 19 in conjunction with the birthday of our national hero, Jose Rizal, who was also an artist himself, and is on view until July 2. “Figura Filipina ATBP” will feature a selection of artworks from the Art Association of Malabon headed by Chairman August Santiago along with other well-known Filipino artists such as Nemi Miranda who is famous for his Imaginative Figurism style and Mike Pastorizo whose artworks continue to mesmerize the audience with its vibrant colors. Other notable artists who will display their artworks in the exhibit include Dolphee Alcantara, Ash Forlaje, Rhoss Gadiana, and Chris Magbuhos. The featured artists used acrylic and oil as their medium to create aesthetically-pleasing masterpieces which will allow the audience to feel and understand the message behind the artwork.
